title: Shopify theme building for Siba Vitamins
description: Siba Vitamins company is a Shopify E-commerce store where I started to learn about web designs, product information, categories, metadata, SEO and, DNS configuration.
body:
Making a change from Network Security and support to build a theme in Shopify was a weird change to be honest but, it was entertaining to start building my carrier and learning about this topic. 

when I started to help my sister with their e-commerce of vitamins and supplements in Shopify. It was a challenge but not difficult...nothing that a IT person can't learn in a few days of burning your eyes with a lot of knowledge. 

Understanding the basic of how actually Shopify works in *terms of making your on theme* is not that easy even if you use AI. While coding is not my field, I decided to put my knowledge in learning the right prompt for the AI to work on my way without spending much tokens and making a mess. 

If you are getting into AI and wants to build a website you need to understand the Shopify Theme Workflow and here I will make a little breakdown: 

**`layout/`-**  The main page framework, including `theme.liquid`. 

**`templates/` -** Page layouts for homepage, products, collections, blog, cart, and search. 

**`sections/`** **\-** Editable page components, such as the header, footer, hero banner, ad featured products. 

**`snippets/ `-** Reusable pieces, such as product cards, prices, and SEO tags.

**`blocks/` -** Smaller components that can be placed inside compatible sections.

**`assets/` -** CSS, JavaScript, logos, images, and font lines. 

**`config/` -** Theme editor settings and their saved values.

**`locales/` -** Translations for buttons, labels, and theme messages. 

Find more info in <https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts/themes/architecture>

Once you have an idea of this theme directories, your prompt will be easier for the AI to understand your project. However, that does not mean you will copy and paste and that's it...even thought sounds good and we expect the AI to do the work...sadly...the AI will not get it as you think. I will share some of my prompts that helped me to make the theme get builded and thought the time you improve it.  Also Codex or Claude has /skills and /planmode where you give the AI specific task to do. 

#### Plan the theme prompt

Help me plan a custom Shopify theme from scratch for "**brand name**", a store selling "**product type**" to "**target audience**". The visual style should be "**minimal, premium, colorful, natural, etc.**". Use "**colors**" and "**font preferences**".

I need a homepage, product pages, collection pages, a blog, an article page, an About page, a contact page, search, and a cart. Describe the page structure and reusable sections before writing code. Identify which content belongs in the theme and which belongs in Shopify’s database. Ask me about missing information that would materially affect the design. Do not invent product claims, reviews, prices, or business policies.
